name: CNP Assurances
desc: Major French personal insurer selling life, savings, pension and borrower cover through La Banque Postale and partner banks in Europe and Brazil.
products: Life insurance and savings, pensions, borrower insurance, personal risk and health cover; Filassistance assistance subsidiary
customers: Retail customers via La Banque Postale, BPCE and other partner networks; Brazil via Caixa partnership
parent_ultimate: La Poste group (French state and Caisse des Depots)
marketing_autonomy_basis: Own brand, newsroom, sustainability rankings and foundation
markets: France, other European countries (Italy, Luxembourg, Cyprus) and Latin America, mainly Brazil
profitability_basis: French Wikipedia states net income EUR 1.9bn for 2022 (older figure)
